diagnostic.text:
import RegistrationAuditedUpdateWitnessExecution

/-! PRIVATE deliberate-model-fault diagnostic. No generic audited UPDATE
correctness or successful-output proof is imported. Expected wrong output is
independent:full qualified data result,prior complete ledger,empty audit cursor.
The existing executable fixture/Step proofs are unchanged under the mutation. -/
namespace RegistrationAuditedUpdate.OmissionDiagnostic
open RegistrationAuditedUpdate
open RegistrationAuditedLifetime
open RegistrationAuditedUpdate.Witnesses
open RegistrationTransaction (put)

def emptyCursor : Cursor String Draft Nat := ⟨[], [], []⟩

def WrongOutput : Prop :=
  acknowledged.core.core.db = expectedDB ∧ acknowledged.audit = priorAudit ∧
    acknowledged.core.core.lock = none ∧
    acknowledged.core.updates = put (fun _ => ({ request } : Tx)) 0 expectedTx ∧
    acknowledged.core.core.transactions = (fun id => ({ request := registrations id } :
      RegistrationTransaction.Transaction Nat Nat (Metadata × String) Payload String)) ∧
    acknowledged.core.core.commits = [] ∧ acknowledged.core.events = [.update 0 expectedWrites] ∧
    acknowledged.cursors = put (fun _ => none) 0 (some emptyCursor)

/-- No append Step exists in this concrete helper call;the modified run has
8actual transitions,with the optional append replaced by reflexivity. -/
theorem append_stutters : appended = auditBegun ∧ finalCursor.acknowledged = [] := by
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

theorem legal_execution : Execution methods metadataAccepted source encoding start acknowledged :=
  update_execution

theorem wrong_slots : acknowledged.audit 100 = none ∧
    acknowledged.audit 900 = some priorRecord := by
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

theorem wrong_complete_output : WrongOutput := by
  refine ⟨update_database, rfl, rfl, ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  funext id
  by_cases actor : id = 0
  · subst id
    rfl
  have otherWriting (s : World) (tx : Tx) (lock : Option Nat) :
      (writing s tx lock).core.updates id = s.core.updates id := by
    simp only [writing, RegistrationUpdate.updateTx, put, if_neg actor]
  have appendedUpdates : appended.core.updates = ready.core.updates := rfl
  have retained : acknowledged.core.updates id = start.core.updates id := by
    calc
      acknowledged.core.updates id = committed.core.updates id := otherWriting _ _ _
      _ = committing.core.updates id := by
        simp only [committed, RegistrationUpdate.committedState,
          RegistrationUpdate.updateTx, put, if_neg actor]
      _ = appended.core.updates id := otherWriting _ _ _
      _ = ready.core.updates id := congrFun appendedUpdates id
      _ = metadataWritten.core.updates id := otherWriting _ _ _
      _ = begun.core.updates id := otherWriting _ _ _
      _ = preflight.core.updates id := otherWriting _ _ _
      _ = start.core.updates id := otherWriting _ _ _
  simp only [put, if_neg actor]
  rw [retained]
  rfl

/-- Explicit contradiction of the ORIGINAL independent output predicate. The
operation succeeds and commits data,but its required audit100 is absent. -/
theorem rejects_original_acceptance : ¬UpdateAccepted := by
  intro accepted
  have slot := congrFun (show acknowledged.audit = expectedAudit from accepted.2.1) 100
  change acknowledged.audit 100 = some updateRecord at slot
  rw [wrong_slots.1] at slot
  cases slot

theorem actual_data_success : (acknowledged.core.updates 0).phase = .committed ∧
    (acknowledged.core.updates 0).response = .success ∧ acknowledged.core.core.lock = none ∧
    acknowledged.core.events = [.update 0 expectedWrites] := by
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem omission_detected : RegistrationTransaction.WellFormed seedDB ∧
    Execution methods metadataAccepted source encoding start acknowledged ∧ WrongOutput ∧
    acknowledged.audit 100 = none ∧ ¬UpdateAccepted := by
  exact ⟨seed_wellFormed, legal_execution, wrong_complete_output, wrong_slots.1, rejects_original_acceptance⟩

#print axioms legal_execution
#print axioms wrong_complete_output
#print axioms rejects_original_acceptance
#print axioms omission_detected

run_cmd do
  for declaration in [``append_stutters, ``legal_execution, ``wrong_slots,
      ``wrong_complete_output, ``rejects_original_acceptance, ``actual_data_success,
      ``omission_detected] do
    let axioms ← Lean.collectAxioms declaration
    for name in axioms do
      unless name == ``propext || name == ``Classical.choice || name == ``Quot.sound do
        throwError "unexpected UPDATE omission diagnostic axiom in {declaration}: {name}"

end RegistrationAuditedUpdate.OmissionDiagnostic

scenario.expected_wrong_output: Complete original expectedDB and successful update transaction/event; ledger equals priorAudit with no record100, complete prior900 retained; cursor0 contains empty source/pending/acknowledged lists; full other transaction/cursor maps and lock match independent output.

scenario.negative_acceptance: Independent diagnostic proves not UpdateAccepted, while actual data commit/store success is proved.
